node.statement: Work on the explicit branch S_P != {0}. Choose Z_0 in S_P with Z_0 != 0. Then R={||h_1(Z)||/||Z||: 0 != Z in S_P} is nonempty. Every member of R is a finite nonnegative real, and R is bounded below by 0; therefore a_1=inf R exists as a finite nonnegative real. This removes the empty-infimum issue; the separate S_P=0 branch is not asserted in this node.
